title: A header strip line whose run declares no face is size x the inherited face's factor, like the body: sz 32 Calibri pitch 19.52, sz 16 9.76, CJK inheriting SimSun 15.60, an empty paragraph the mark's own Latin face
source: probe build.py -> Word for Mac direct PDF (2026-10-29), pymupdf: Letter 1440 margins, header 720, docDefaults Calibri 11 / eastAsia SimSun; br-line pitches 19.44-19.68 (sz 32), 9.60-9.84 (sz 16), 13.44 (inherited 11pt), 15.60 (SimSun sz 24); body tops 94.61 / 72.05 / 76.37 / 82.61; four Times New Roman sz 16 empty marks over a Calibri line push the body to 86.21 = 36 + 4 x 9.2 + 13.42, four bare empty paragraphs to 103.25 = 36 + 5 x 13.42; control Calibri 11 declared pitch 13.44. gen re-evaluated the strip factor only when a run declared a Latin face and otherwise kept the page's computed line height

cases.note: sz 32 run inheriting Calibri: the strip paragraph re-declares its line height from the Latin factor
everything inherited: still size x face x document multiple, not the page's computed pixels
CJK run inheriting the docDefaults eastAsia face: the document CJK var (SimSun 1.30)
empty paragraph with a Times New Roman sz 16 mark: the mark's Latin face, 9.2 pt lines
bare empty paragraph: the inherited Latin face at the strip size, 13.42 pt
